independence.arithmetic: fractions.Fraction only; no float or finite field

visibility_definition.meaning: A commutator is reachable-visible when it acts nontrivially on at least one genuine compiled cylinder state in the common representation space.
visibility_definition.chronology_nonclaim: This is operator action on a physical state, not a claim that mixed-stage Q_i Q_j is itself a legal chronological growth word.

search_terminal_reason: This audits one frozen witness only; it neither constructs nor obstructs a rank-two reachable-visible witness in the full weak/weak profile.
claim_boundary: The frozen SR2 witness has exact reachable rank one and all six nonzero Q commutators annihilate every compiled cylinder state. This does not imply that all weak/weak CPOBC representations share that property.
